name: 33165 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33165 (Miami) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33165 (Miami) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33165 (Miami) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
